# 1. Introduction
In this report, I am presenting results of metabarcoding using 18S rRNA marker gene (region V9) from mesocosm warming experiment .
The marker was amplified from both 1) DNA and 2) RNA fractions enabling to obtain 1) taxonomic composition 2) identify active fraction (actively transcribing) of community.
The experiment design required field sampling of 10 t.
of water that was distributed to the tanks.
The field sampling for metabarcoding was done parallelly.
Tanks were exposed for 3-4 weeks to three different temperature conditions - 21 (delta 0), 23 (+2) and 25 (+4)).
The water sampling was done after 2 days acclimatization and then after 3 weeks.
The sediment samples where taken 2 days later on the termination day of the experiment.
Due to drastic die off of the planktonic fraction after 10 days mostly samples from the first sampling were sequenced first, but the samples from second sampling ware sequenced in the second run with some common samples for evaluating batch efect.  
Each water sample was filtered twice - through 5 um filter to obtain the particle-associated (PA) fraction enriched in protists and through 0.22 um filter to obtain free-living (FL) - mainly prokaryotic fraction.
The RNA and DNA fractions from the first round were used for 18S marker gene/18 rRNA sequencing to understand the eukaryotic community shift and active fraction of the community due to different conditions.
The same was applied for DNA and RNA sediment samples and corresponding DNA water samples from second round of sampling were sequenced do understand if stated conditions had an effect on vertical migration of microbes into sediment.
Data preprocessing and partial analysis were done in qiime2 and continued in the following R script.


```{r}
library("phyloseq")
library("ggplot2")
library("vegan")
library("dplyr")
library("tidyr")
devtools::install_github("pmartinezarbizu/pairwiseAdonis/pairwiseAdonis")
library(pairwiseAdonis)
setwd("/YOUR/PATH")
#no samples names in header
#manually removed # 
otu <- read.table("feature-table-rare.tsv", header=T,
                        check.names=F, sep="\t", row.names = 1)
samples <- read.table("metadata2nd.txt", header=T,
                     check.names=F, sep="\t", row.names = 1)
#for clear legend and easier coding
samples$conditions <- samples$"`temperature elevation`"
samples$conditions[which(samples$"`temperature elevation`"=="-")] <- "field"
samples$conditions[which(samples$"`temperature elevation`"=="0")] <- "tank delta 0"
samples$conditions[which(samples$"`temperature elevation`"=="2")] <- "tank delta 2"
samples$conditions[which(samples$"`temperature elevation`"=="4")] <- "tank delta 4"
weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix <- read.table("diversity-core-metrics-phylogenetic/weighted_unifrac_distance-matrix.tsv", header=T,
                                               check.names=F, sep="\t", row.names = 1)
weighted_unifrac_dist <- as.dist(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) 
taxa <- row.names(otu)
```
# 2. Visualise beta diversity
## 2.1 All samples
```{r}
samples_names <- row.names(samples)
sum_vec <- as.vector(apply(otu, 1, sum))
otu.nonzero <- otu[which(sum_vec!=0),]
otu.nonzero <- as.matrix(otu.nonzero)
taxa.nonzero <- taxa[which(sum_vec!=0)]
taxa.nonzero <- as.matrix(taxa.nonzero)
col <- which(colnames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_names)
row <- which(rownames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_names)

weighted_unifrac_dist <- as.dist(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix[row, col]) 

row.names(taxa.nonzero) <- taxa.nonzero[,1]

ps_all <- phyloseq(otu_table(otu.nonzero, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), 
                   sample_data(samples), 
                   taxa_names(taxa.nonzero))
palette <- c( 
  "#4a7c2e", 
  "#365ea4", 
  "#d6a01b", 
  "#c15208" )
#try unifrac;
ord.pcoa.weighted_unifrac_dist <- ordinate(ps_all, method="PCoA", distance=weighted_unifrac_dist, na.rm = T)

p<-plot_ordination(ps_all, ord.pcoa.weighted_unifrac_dist, color="conditions")
p<-plot_ordination(ps_all, ord.pcoa.weighted_unifrac_dist, color="fraction")
p<-plot_ordination(ps_all, ord.pcoa.weighted_unifrac_dist, color="sequencing")
#divide by sampling turn 
p$data$week <- p$data$sampling_date
p$data$week[which(p$data$week=="21/08/2024")] <- "3rd week"
p$data$week[which(p$data$week=="23/08/2024")] <- "3rd week"
p$data$fraction[which(p$data$fraction=="")] <- "sediment"
p$data$week[which(p$data$week!="3rd week")] <- "1st week"
p$data$fraction[which(p$data$fraction=="FL")] <- "<5 µm"
p$data$fraction[which(p$data$fraction=="PA")] <- ">5 µm"
p$data$all <- paste(p$data$week, p$data$fraction) 
#check sequencing effect - no batch effect
ggplot(data=p$data, aes(x=Axis.1, y=Axis.2, label=rownames(p$data), color= sequencing, shape = fraction )) + geom_point(size= 3) + geom_text(hjust=0, vjust=0) + labs(x="PC1", y= "PC2") + theme_minimal()
#visualise fractions,  conditions and week of sampling
tiff("plot_all_mesocosm.tiff", unit="cm", width = 30, height=20, res=300)
p_all<- ggplot(data=p$data, aes(x=Axis.1, y=Axis.2, color= conditions, shape = all)) + geom_point(size= 3, stroke=2, fill="black")+ labs(x="PC1", y= "PC2")  + scale_color_manual(values=palette) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 15, 1, 16, 13), name="sample") + facet_grid(vars(DNA_or_RNA)) + theme_minimal(base_size = 20)
dev.off()
pdf("plot_all_mesocosm.pdf", width = 15, height=10)
p_all
dev.off()
png("plot_all_mesocosm.png", unit="px", width = 600, height=400)
p_all
dev.off()
jpeg("plot_all_mesocosm.jpeg", unit="px", width = 1000, height=800)
p_all
dev.off()
p_all
p$data$all <- paste(p$data$week, p$data$fraction,  p$data$DNA_or_RNA) 
pdf("plot_all_mesocosm_the_same_coordinates.pdf", width = 15, height=10)
p_cor <- ggplot(data=p$data, aes(x=Axis.1, y=Axis.2, color= conditions, shape = all)) + geom_point(size= 3, stroke=2, fill="black")+ labs(x="PC1", y= "PC2")  + scale_color_manual(values=palette) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 15, 1, 16, 13, 22, 21, 2), name="sample")  + theme_minimal(base_size = 20)
dev.off()
p_cor
```

# 3. Statistical test for grouping
## 3.1 First sampling
### 3.11 PA DNA

```{r}
#only PA
samples_PA_DNA_1 <- samples[which(samples$fraction == "PA" & samples$sampling_date == "31/07/2024" & samples$DNA_or_RNA == "DNA" & samples$sequencing == "1"),]
samples_names <- row.names(samples_PA_DNA_1)
col <- which(colnames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_names)
row <- which(rownames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_names)
weighted_unifrac_dist_PA_DNA_1 <- as.dist(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix[row, col])
#97D was removed as outlier
#keep the same samples in the metadata
samples_PA_DNA_1 <- samples_PA_DNA_1[which(rownames(samples_PA_DNA_1) %in% colnames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix)[col]),]
attach(samples_PA_DNA_1)
condition.ano_PA <- anosim(weighted_unifrac_dist_PA_DNA_1, conditions)
summary(condition.ano_PA)
PA.adonis2 <- adonis2(weighted_unifrac_dist_PA_DNA_1 ~ conditions, data=samples_PA_DNA_1)
PA.adonis2
res <- pairwiseAdonis::pairwise.adonis(weighted_unifrac_dist_PA_DNA_1, samples_PA_DNA_1$conditions)
res
```

# 3.2  DNA vs RNA - check shift in relative activity 
# 3.21 PA
```{r}
#only PA
samples_PA <- samples[which(samples$fraction == "PA" & samples$sequencing == "1" & (samples$sampling_date == "29/07/2024" | samples$sampling_date == "31/07/2024")),]
samples_names <- row.names(samples_PA)
col <- which(colnames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_names)
row <- which(rownames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_names)
weighted_unifrac_dist_PA <- as.dist(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix[row, col])
#keep the same samples in the metadata
samples_PA <- samples_PA[which(rownames(samples_PA) %in% colnames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix)[col]),]
attach(samples_PA)
DNA_or_RNA.ano_PA <- anosim(weighted_unifrac_dist_PA, DNA_or_RNA)
summary(DNA_or_RNA.ano_PA)
PA.adonis2 <- adonis2(weighted_unifrac_dist_PA ~  DNA_or_RNA, data=samples_PA)
PA.adonis2
res <- pairwiseAdonis::pairwise.adonis(weighted_unifrac_dist_PA, samples_PA$DNA_or_RNA)
res
```

```{r}
row <- which(rownames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_names)
weighted_unifrac_dist_FL <- as.dist(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix[row, col])
#keep the same samples in the metadata
samples_FL <- samples_FL[which(rownames(samples_FL) %in% colnames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix)[col]),]
attach(samples_FL)
DNA_or_RNA.ano_FL <- anosim(weighted_unifrac_dist_FL, DNA_or_RNA)
summary(DNA_or_RNA.ano_FL)
FL.adonis2 <- adonis2(weighted_unifrac_dist_FL ~  DNA_or_RNA, data=samples_FL)
FL.adonis2
res <- pairwiseAdonis::pairwise.adonis(weighted_unifrac_dist_FL, samples_FL$DNA_or_RNA)
res
```

```{r}
taxa_level3$sampling_site[which(taxa_level3$sampling_site=="3J")] <-"3I"

  pivot_longer(!colnames(taxa_level3)[17:27], names_to = "taxa", values_to = "count") %>% filter(count>0)

taxa_dna <- ggplot(data=taxa_level3_long_DNA, aes(x=alias, y=count, fill=taxa)) +
```

#6 Phytoplankton analysis 
Separate analysis for following groups of phytoplankton: Bacillariophyceae, Chlorophyceae (Green algae), Chrysophyceae (yes), cyanophycea - should not be in our data - 18S, Mediophyceae, Trebouxiophyceae, Zygnematophyceae.

```{r}

#Separate analysis for following groups: Bacillariophyceae (Bacillariophyta) (yes), Chlorophyceae (Green algae) (yes), Chrysophyceae (yes), cyanophycea - should not be in our data - 18S, Mediophyceae (class of bacillariophycea - Polar-centric-Mediophyceae - use for Bacillariophyce all beside this one), Trebouxiophyceae - class of green algae (Chlorophyceae)(yes), Zygnematophyceae - class of green algae (no).
taxa_level9_long <- taxa_level9 %>%
  pivot_longer(!colnames(taxa_level9)[44:54], names_to = "taxa", values_to = "count") %>% filter(count>0) %>% separate( col=taxa, sep = ";", into=c("level_1", "level_2", "level_3", "level_4", "level_5", "level_6", "level_7")) #split taxa column into multiple by ";"
taxa_level9_long <-  taxa_level9_long %>% mutate(level_7_merged= paste( level_1, level_2, level_3, level_4, level_5, level_6, level_7, sep = ';'))
taxa_phytoplankton <- taxa_level9_long[which(taxa_level9_long$level_4 %in% c("Bacillariophyta", "Trebouxiophyceae", "Chrysophyceae")),]
#barplot 
taxa_sed <- taxa_phytoplankton %>% filter(type=="Sediment") %>% ggplot(aes(x=sampling_site, y=count, fill=level_4)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1)) + scale_fill_manual(values = colours) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + facet_grid(rows = vars(DNA_or_RNA))

taxa_sed <- taxa_phytoplankton %>% filter(type=="Sediment") %>% ggplot(aes(x=sampling_site, y=count, fill=level_7_merged)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1)) + scale_fill_manual(values = colours) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + facet_grid(rows = vars(DNA_or_RNA))
#still should be relative abundance but zoomed and the rest "other", or relative across smaples?

taxa_sed
#for water
taxa_water <- taxa_phytoplankton %>% filter(type=="Water") %>% ggplot(aes(x=sampling_site, y=count, fill=level_7_merged)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1)) + scale_fill_manual(values = colours) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + facet_grid(rows = vars(DNA_or_RNA), cols = vars(fraction))

taxa_water
#for all
taxa_all <- taxa_phytoplankton %>% ggplot(aes(x=sampling_site, y=count, fill=level_7_merged)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1)) + scale_fill_manual(values = colours) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + facet_grid(rows = vars(`type`), cols = vars(DNA_or_RNA))
```

# 7. Alpha diversity analysis
How diversity differs in different size fractions (organisms sizes) under different temperature conditions over time of the experiment. Compare alpha diversity for DNA and RNA samples separatelely. 
```{r}
library(ggpubr)
richness <- estimate_richness(ps_all, measures=c( "Observed", "Simpson", "Shannon")) 
symnum<- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
#all alpha diversity meassurments


plot_richness(ps_DNA, x="conditions", measures=c( "Observed", "Simpson", "Shannon")) + geom_boxplot() + theme_bw(base_size=20) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) #+ 
plot_richness(ps_DNA, x="conditions", measures=c( "Simpson")) + geom_boxplot() + theme_bw(base_size=20) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) + facet_grid(fraction ~ sampling_date) + geom_pwc(method ="dunn_test", hide.ns =F, label = "p.signif", symnum.args=symnum) #+ 

labels_names <- list(
  ''="sediment",
  'FL'="water <5 µm",
  'PA'="water >5 µm")
###RNA water samples
#RNA
samples_RNA <- samples[which(samples$DNA_or_RNA == "RNA" & samples$type == "ater"),]
samples_RNA_names <- row.names(samples_RNA)
otu_RNA <- otu[, which(colnames(otu) %in% samples_RNA_names)]
sum_vec <- as.vector(apply(otu_RNA, 1, sum))
otu.nonzero <- otu[which(sum_vec!=0),]
otu.nonzero <- as.matrix(otu.nonzero)
taxa.nonzero <- taxa[which(sum_vec!=0)]
taxa.nonzero <- as.matrix(taxa.nonzero)
col <- which(colnames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_RNA_names)
row <- which(rownames(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix) %in% samples_RNA_names)

weighted_unifrac_dist <- as.dist(weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix[row, col]) 

row.names(taxa.nonzero) <- taxa.nonzero[,1]

ps_RNA <- phyloseq(otu_table(otu.nonzero, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), 
                   sample_data(samples_RNA), 
                   taxa_names(taxa.nonzero))
palette <- c( 
  "#4a7c2e", 
  "#365ea4", 
  "#d6a01b", 
  "#c15208" )
#try unifrac;
ord.pcoa.weighted_unifrac_dist <- ordinate(ps_RNA, method="PCoA", distance=weighted_unifrac_dist, na.rm = T)

p<-plot_ordination(ps_RNA, ord.pcoa.weighted_unifrac_dist, color="conditions")
p<-plot_ordination(ps_RNA, ord.pcoa.weighted_unifrac_dist, color="fraction")
p<-plot_ordination(ps_RNA, ord.pcoa.weighted_unifrac_dist, color="sequencing")
#divide by sampling turn 
p$data$week <- p$data$sampling_date
p$data$week[which(p$data$week=="21/08/2024")] <- "3rd week"
p$data$week[which(p$data$week=="23/08/2024")] <- "3rd week"
p$data$fraction[which(p$data$fraction=="")] <- "sediment"
p$data$fraction[which(p$data$fraction=="FL")] <- "<5 µm"
p$data$fraction[which(p$data$fraction=="PA")] <- ">5 µm"
p$data$week[which(p$data$week!="3rd week")] <- "1st week"
p$data$all <- paste(p$data$week, p$data$fraction) 

plot_richness(ps_RNA, x="conditions", measures=c("Simpson")) + geom_boxplot() + theme_bw(base_size=20) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) + facet_grid(fraction ~ ., labeller = labels_names) + geom_pwc(method ="dunn_test", hide.ns ="p", label = "p.signif", symnum.args=symnum)   #+ 

tiff("Alpha_diversity_Salinity.tiff",units = 'px', width = 1000, height = 500)
dev.off()
```
